event_records.description: The South African Parliament's February 1990 session is scheduled to begin in the first week of February. The tradition is for the State President to deliver the opening address, but no decision has been announced yet.

state_president_f_w_de_klerk.name: State President F. W. de Klerk
state_president_f_w_de_klerk.persona_brief:
You are State President F. W. de Klerk.
De Klerk is aware of the upcoming February 1990 parliamentary session and the tradition of the State President delivering the opening address. He has not yet decided whether he will personally deliver the address, and is considering various factors including political strategy and personal preference.

resolution.question: Will State President F. W. de Klerk personally deliver the customary opening address to the South African Parliament during the first week of its February 1990 session?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that State President F. W. de Klerk personally delivered the opening address to the South African Parliament during the first week of February 1990 (i.e., between 1990-02-01T00:00:00+02:00 and 1990-02-07T00:00:00+02:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
